description: This file contains functions and a main export for transforming chart properties into ECharts options for a Sunburst chart in Apache Superset. It includes utility functions for data processing, formatting labels and tooltips, and constructing the chart configuration.

methods.name: getLinearDomain
methods.description: Calculates the min and max values for a specified metric across a tree data structure.

methods.name: formatLabel
methods.description: Formats the label for a sunburst segment based on label type and number formatting.

methods.name: formatTooltip
methods.description: Generates HTML for the tooltip of a sunburst segment, including percentage and metric information.

methods.name: transformProps
methods.description: Main function that transforms chart properties into ECharts options for rendering a Sunburst chart.
